analyzed_vuln.description: In xmlSkipBlankChars, the fast path dereferences `*cur` without validating that `ctxt->input->cur` is within the current input buffer. With malformed/fuzzed parser state reached during prolog/Misc parsing, `ctxt->input->cur` can point before valid buffer data, so `while (IS_BLANK_CH(*cur))` performs a 1-byte out-of-bounds read (global-buffer-overflow). Crash is observed from xmlParseMisc/xmlParseDocument, but the missing bounds/state check is in xmlSkipBlankChars.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Via the xinclude harness, attacker-controlled bytes are passed to `xmlReadMemory(..., opts|XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE)`. A highly malformed document can drive parser state into xmlParseDocument -> xmlParseMisc -> SKIP_BLANKS -> xmlSkipBlankChars with an invalid `ctxt->input->cur` pointer. When xmlSkipBlankChars enters its fast path (`inputNr==1` and not DTD, or START state), it reads `*cur` immediately and loops on blanks, triggering OOB read if `cur` is outside buffer bounds.
